label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf): Resolved sink value is `host` derived from user input `param`. Although there is an IP check (lines 21-22), it only blocks 10.x and 192.168.x ranges. It fails to block loopback (127.0.0.1) or other private ranges (172.x.x.x). An attacker can provide `127.0.0.1` to bypass the check and connect to internal services. Thus, the sink remains attacker-controlled.

evidence.note: User input flows into host variable; IP check excludes 10./192.168. but misses 127.0.0.1, allowing SSRF via loopback.
